summary: Added a fail-closed machine-readable DXVK performance evidence readiness gate and reconciled the DXVK performance queue to hardware evidence pending.
behavior_verified: DxvkPerformanceEvidenceReady requires DxvkDirectEvidenceTrusted=true, which already covers exact-build identity, package integrity, host/import generation, active host-owned direct path, and DirectFrames>0.
DxvkPerformanceEvidenceReady requires host capture, commit-copy, render, and xrEndFrame budget windows.
DxvkPerformanceEvidenceReady requires at least one R32 game-producer performance window.
Incomplete evidence is fail-closed through DxvkPerformanceEvidenceBlockers.
Hosted regression fixture proves a complete synthetic DXVK PERFORMANCE bundle becomes decision-ready without claiming a performance PASS.
VR-PERF-COMMON-001 remains runtime UNTESTED and is now NEED_HMD_TEST.
scope: Analyzer/test/queue only; no renderer, DXVK provider, DirectGPU synchronization/resource lifetime, OpenXR submission, cadence, copy count, wait policy, or draw behavior changed.
blocker: A real DXVK performance bottleneck cannot be selected until Quest3/VDXR exact-build PERFORMANCE evidence satisfies DxvkPerformanceEvidenceReady=true.
next_action: Run an exact-build Quest3/VDXR DXVK PERFORMANCE session. If DxvkPerformanceEvidenceReady=true, use FrameBudget to choose the measured dominant stage; otherwise resolve DxvkPerformanceEvidenceBlockers without speculative wait/copy/draw tuning.
